overview.en:
This standalone Recipe is the reference input for a two-node PD-disaggregated
deployment. It intentionally contains only the script-backed scenario consumed
by the new multi-node converter.
overview.zh:
这份独立 Recipe 是双节点 PD 分离部署的参考输入，只包含新多节点
Converter 消费的 script-backed 场景，不依赖已有模型文档中的场景。

env_setup.container.A2.content.en:
Start the vLLM Ascend container on both nodes with the Ascend driver,
HCCN configuration, model cache, and two selected NPU devices mounted.
env_setup.container.A2.content.zh:
在两个节点上启动 vLLM Ascend 容器，并挂载 Ascend 驱动、HCCN 配置、
模型缓存和两个选定的 NPU 设备。

scenarios[0].steps[0].content.en:
`1p1d` means one Prefill node and one Decode node. Each node runs two
external-DP ranks on two NPUs (`DP=2`, `TP=1`). Set the node addresses
and optionally override the selected devices:

```bash
export PREFILL_NODE_0_IP="${PREFILL_NODE_0_IP:-<prefill_node_0_ip>}"
export DECODE_NODE_0_IP="${DECODE_NODE_0_IP:-<decode_node_0_ip>}"
export GATEWAY_NODE_0_IP="${GATEWAY_NODE_0_IP:-$PREFILL_NODE_0_IP}"
export PREFILL_NODE_0_DEVICES="${PREFILL_NODE_0_DEVICES:-0,1}"
export DECODE_NODE_0_DEVICES="${DECODE_NODE_0_DEVICES:-0,1}"
```
scenarios[0].steps[0].content.zh:
`1p1d` 表示 1 个 Prefill 节点和 1 个 Decode 节点。每个节点使用两张
NPU 运行两个 external-DP rank（`DP=2`、`TP=1`）。请设置节点地址，
并按需覆盖设备列表：

```bash
export PREFILL_NODE_0_IP="${PREFILL_NODE_0_IP:-<prefill_node_0_ip>}"
export DECODE_NODE_0_IP="${DECODE_NODE_0_IP:-<decode_node_0_ip>}"
export GATEWAY_NODE_0_IP="${GATEWAY_NODE_0_IP:-$PREFILL_NODE_0_IP}"
export PREFILL_NODE_0_DEVICES="${PREFILL_NODE_0_DEVICES:-0,1}"
export DECODE_NODE_0_DEVICES="${DECODE_NODE_0_DEVICES:-0,1}"
```
